desc:
🚐 YOUR ROAD TRIP HAS GONE VERY WRONG! 🌲⚠️

🚙 Drive an RV or pickup truck
🔩 Collect scrap, cash, tools, and supplies
🔧 Repair damage and refill your motor oil
🪝 Use winches and planks to escape tough situations
🍔 Grill burgers and use food, cola, and medicine
💥 Survive landmines, snakes, fire, falls, and crashes
❤️ Rescue and revive your downed teammates
🏁 Reach checkpoints and unlock badges
🎨 Open crates and collect rare vehicle skins

👑 Can your crew survive all 6 stages—or will the forest claim your ride?

👥 Team up with friends for the ultimate chaotic road trip!
🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet
👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for future updates!

💡 Inspired by RV There Yet?
